method: Direct import of the supplied public M3U catalog; no cross-catalog matching.

transport_sample.method: HTTP first-byte sample with an 8-second per-channel timeout; not FFprobe, decode, or identity verification.

probe_sample.method: Same-catalog alias match followed by bounded FFprobe and 2-second FFmpeg decode; dry-run only; no visible identity verification.

stream_url_policy: Imported URLs are retained exactly as supplied. This snapshot does not claim current playback, stream quality, or visible identity.
logo_policy: Logo bytes were fetched from each supplied tvg-logo URL and checked into logo/ under stable local filenames.

repository_profile.language_policy: Chinese-labelled channels use Chinese; other labels use English.
